(* [IMG_RO_LO, IMG_RO_HI) is the whole read-only PT_LOAD of fuzz_pcap.asan (sha256 b7a91d9b1fb0...): p_vaddr 0x10000,
p_memsz 0x1ef70, so it ends at 0x2ef70.  Its sections are .note.gnu.build-id [0x102a8, 0x102cc), .rodata
[0x102e0, 0x2266c), .eh_frame_hdr [0x2266c, 0x246e8) and .eh_frame [0x246e8, 0x2ef70); IMG_RO_HI is the end of
.eh_frame.  elf_snapshot maps the segment page-rounded, as tfibsegs' first segment [0x10000, 0x2f000), whose tail
[0x2ef70, 0x2f000) holds file bytes of .text; img_ro_seg0 below checks that segment against IMG_RO_LO / IMG_RO_HI.
The relocation wrote 0x2ee40 here: the donor's 0x2f1ac, which sits 0x130 below cgif's read-only PT_LOAD end 0x2f2dc,
moved with that gap.  0x2ee40 is no boundary of fuzz_pcap.asan (it is 0x20 bytes into the .eh_frame FDE at 0x2ee20),
so the bound is restated to the segment end (2026-10-29).  The last chunk of img_ro_chunks ends at IMG_RO_HI and
grows with it; no AF0m Tfib_owned_static row lies in [0x2134a, 0x2ef70). *)
